finding: The problem is real, but the mechanism is reducible to a fixed held-out regression/cost gate rather than an identifiable learned admission mechanism.
finding_zh: 问题真实，但当前机制可被固定的留出回归／成本门控复现，不能识别为独立的学习型准入机制。
required_action: Retire this thesis; any child must define a materially different learned admission object and beat a matched fixed regression gate on untouched future tasks.
required_action_zh: 退役当前主张；后续子方向必须定义实质不同的学习型准入对象，并在未触及的未来任务上优于完全匹配的固定回归门控。

finding: Contradiction preservation matters, but the learned consolidator is not isolated from contradiction-aware non-learned retention.
finding_zh: 保留反证很重要，但学习型巩固器尚未与反证感知的非学习保留策略区分。
required_action: Use fixed-capacity oracle-verifiable conclusion-change cases with crossed deletion interventions; compare learned consolidation with contradiction-aware and utility retention under identical memory/retrieval budgets.
required_action_zh: 使用固定容量、Oracle 可验证的结论改变案例和交叉删除干预；在相同存储／检索预算下对比学习型巩固、反证感知保留和效用保留。

finding: Order-sensitive composition survives, but the proposed representation is not separated from a generic ordered-composition predictor.
finding_zh: 顺序敏感的组合问题成立，但所提交互表示尚未与通用有序组合预测器区分。
required_action: Freeze one persistent update surface and preregister disjoint reversed-pair and three-update tests against a capacity/data/budget-matched ordered-composition predictor.
required_action_zh: 冻结一个持久更新表面，并预注册互斥的反向二元顺序和三更新测试，与容量／数据／预算匹配的有序组合预测器比较。

finding: A behavioral trust region is plausible, but its divergence representation is not isolated from simpler outcome or edit-level gates.
finding_zh: 行为信赖域有合理性，但其分布差异表示尚未与更简单的结果门控或编辑级门控区分。
required_action: Use one non-parametric update surface, predefine an independent behavioral-divergence estimator and threshold, and compare with matched outcome-only, current-gain, and text-edit predictors.
required_action_zh: 限定一个非参数更新表面，预定义独立行为差异估计器与阈值，并与匹配的结果门控、当前收益门控和文本编辑预测器比较。

finding: Reusable executable correction libraries already overlap strongly; the surviving boundary is minimal causally necessary typed-action conjunctions with transfer.
finding_zh: 可复用可执行纠错库已有较强重叠；剩余边界是最小因果必要的类型化动作合取及其迁移。
required_action: Run a matched-budget factorial against an executable correction library plus retrieval of individually intervention-validated repairs, with disjoint failure-composition/domain splits and an independent evaluator.
required_action_zh: 与可执行纠错库及单独经干预验证的修复检索做等预算析因实验；使用失效组合／领域互斥划分和独立终点评价器。

finding: The interaction problem is real, but the split can memorize memory identities and does not isolate clause induction from direct interaction prediction.
finding_zh: 记忆交互问题真实，但当前划分可能记住具体 memory identity，也未把子句归纳与直接交互预测区分。
required_action: Use identity- and composition-disjoint splits; freeze clauses learned from training identities and test new identities/type combinations against a matched pair/triple contextual gate or association-rule learner.
required_action_zh: 采用 identity 与组合均互斥的划分；只用训练 identity 学习并冻结子句，在全新 identity／类型组合上与匹配的二元／三元 contextual gate 或关联规则学习器比较。

finding: Test aging is real, but mutation/merge/retire is not identified beyond learned future-value selection plus diversity control.
finding_zh: 测试老化问题真实，但 mutation／merge／retire 尚未证明超越“学习未来价值 + 多样性约束”的选择器。
required_action: Run a preregistered prequential crossed version stream with mutation ON/OFF and a matched learned future-value plus diversity top-k selector; require a better future-regression-recall versus execution-cost frontier.
required_action_zh: 做预注册的前序版本流交叉实验：mutation 开／关，并加入匹配的未来价值 + 多样性 top-k 选择器；要求未来回归召回—执行成本前沿改善。

finding: Repairing incompatible accepted updates is useful, but the frozen compiler is not distinguished from equally expressive constrained repair search.
finding_zh: 修复已接受更新间的不兼容有价值，但冻结编译器尚未与同等表达能力的受约束修复搜索区分。
required_action: Use held-out incompatibility-template × update-surface cells and compare the frozen no-test-time-search compiler with a memoized capacity/budget-matched constrained graph-search baseline on a disjoint execution suite.
required_action_zh: 使用未见“不兼容模板 × 更新表面”单元，并将冻结、测试时不搜索的编译器与记忆化且容量／预算匹配的受约束图搜索基线比较。

finding: The novelty is narrow: minimal monotone applicability specialization must be necessary beyond generic symbolic applicability learners and precondition-only repair.
finding_zh: 剩余新颖性很窄：必须证明最小单调适用集合专化优于通用符号适用性学习器和仅前置条件修复。
required_action: Compare against complexity-matched ILP/rule induction, decision-tree/rule-list, and precondition-only repair on a frozen predicate vocabulary with disjoint misuse/retention evaluation.
required_action_zh: 在冻结谓词词表上，对比复杂度匹配的 ILP／规则归纳、决策树／规则列表和仅前置条件修复，并在互斥 misuse／retention 集上评测。

finding: Provider-invariant error semantics remain plausible, but the learned latent is unnecessary unless it beats a matched discrete error taxonomy plus provider-specific templates.
finding_zh: Provider 不变错误语义仍可能成立，但若不能优于匹配的离散错误分类 + Provider 专属模板，学习潜变量就没有必要。
required_action: Use a held-out API-family test: source-only training, freeze before target evaluation, and compare with a capacity/data/call/token/optimization/wall-clock-matched discrete taxonomy classifier plus deterministic repair templates.
required_action_zh: 采用未见 API family 测试：仅在源 family 训练、目标评测前冻结，并与容量／数据／调用／token／优化／墙钟均匹配的离散分类器 + 确定性修复模板比较。

finding: A frozen repair grammar survives only if novel production composition, not retrieval or graph-diff templating, causes transfer.
finding_zh: 冻结修复语法只有在新 production 组合而非检索或 graph-diff 模板真正导致迁移时才成立。
required_action: Preregister crossed API × motif holdouts requiring at least two learned productions and excluding whole-repair/diff/subgraph matches; compare retrieval-only, graph-diff template, and composition-disabled controls under identical resources.
required_action_zh: 预注册 API × motif 交叉留出，要求至少组合两个已学习 production，并排除完整 repair／diff／subgraph 匹配；在相同资源下对比检索、graph-diff 模板和禁用组合控制。
